name: zwave-js-ui
title: Z-Wave JS UI
description: Z-Wave JS UI runs a Z-Wave USB controller (Aeotec Z-Stick, Zooz ZST39, Home Assistant Connect ZWA-2…) with a web page to include and configure devices, and offers them to Home Assistant over WebSocket or to an MQTT broker. The controller must be plugged into this host and its path must exist, or the container does not start: find the stable path with ls /dev/serial/by-id/. After deploying, open Settings > Z-Wave, set the serial port to /dev/zwave and generate the security keys.

variables.name: PORT_ZWAVE_JS_UI
variables.label: Web port
variables.description: Host port of the web page

variables.name: PORT_ZWAVE_JS_WS
variables.label: WebSocket port
variables.description: Host port Home Assistant's Z-Wave integration connects to (ws://<this host>:3600)

variables.name: ZWAVE_DEVICE
variables.label: Controller device
variables.description: Host path of the Z-Wave USB stick; a /dev/serial/by-id/... path survives reboots. It appears in the container as /dev/zwave

variables.name: ZWAVE_SESSION_SECRET
variables.label: Session secret
variables.description: Signs the web page's sessions; leave empty and a random one is made
